parameters.name: corporation_id
parameters.description: Filter by the granting Corporation id

parameters.name: vs_operator
parameters.description: Filter by the grantee VS-operator account

parameters.name: participant_id
parameters.description: Filter to entries whose records[] contains a record for this Participant.id

parameters.name: only_active
parameters.description: If true, only return entries with at least one record whose Participant entry is an active participant at now: effective_from set and <= now, effective_until null or > now, revoked null, slashed null (VPR AUTHZ-CHECK-3 step 1). The record's own expiration and period play no part.

parameters.name: modified_after
parameters.description: Only return entries modified strictly after this datetime

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Caps the number of items returned

parameters.name: min_id
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound of the id range cursor

parameters.name: max_id
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound of the id range cursor

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by id ascending (id/+id) or descending (-id, default)

parameters.name: At-Block-Height
parameters.description: Header to query historical state at a specific block height. When provided, returns the state as it was when the specified block finished processing. When omitted, returns the latest indexed state. Must be a positive integer not exceeding the current indexed block height.
